title: Fanmade Music Discs
description: A mod featuring 4 new minecraft discs with unique ways to retrieve them! Credits go to Laudividni on youtube for their amazing music.
body:
# **Enjoy Laudividni's music within minecraft with friends!**

This mod (which i put no effort into all this was for a friend) adds _4_ new music discs to the game. Needing unique items to craft them.

There is one disc which is harder to get than any other... costing 4 bedrock and 2 ghast tears. Can you somehow craft it?

## Dev message

Hey there everyone! This minecraft mod was made for a friend who wanted this music within minecraft. But, also to make it easier for them I've put it on here for anyone to download, but also for the fact that installing java files (.jar) by hand can be confusing and tedious if you are unexperienced. That's where the amazing team who made Modrinth come in! To help installing mods for your enjoyment! I hope whoever downloads this mod likes it including the moderators who test it.

This was all made with MCreator so credits to them for their amazing mod maker software!

I don't have much else to say except for go and subscribe or listen to Laudividni's music on their channel!

## Content

- 4 new music discs
